response.rationale: R3 directly matches the classic MRI features of spinal meningioma: extra-axial, well-circumscribed, T1 intermediate, T2 homogeneously low, and thin rim enhancement without internal enhancement. C1 is merely an anatomical refinement of R3 with no additional raw support. R2 (schwannoma) is less consistent because schwannomas typically show heterogeneous T2 signal and more prominent enhancement, not homogeneous low T2 with thin rim only.

rejected.why: Schwannoma typically presents with heterogeneous T2 signal and more avid enhancement; the homogeneous low T2 and thin rim enhancement without internal enhancement strongly favor meningioma.
